mandatory_caveats: Domain and time scope: North Indian Ocean only (55°E–84.75°E, -0.25°N–24.5°N); January–June 2023 only. Generalizability to other regions, seasons, or years is not demonstrated.
50-day holdout: Short evaluation window (2023-05-11 to 2023-06-29). Seasonal representativeness is limited.
GLORYS12V1 is a numerical ocean reanalysis benchmark — not physical ground truth. It assimilates satellite and in-situ observations and contains model physics errors.

ARGO observations are sparse independent in-situ measurements: 4 cycle dates, Arabian Sea only, 0m excluded, 0 observations in Bay of Bengal. ARGO RMSE/MAE at individual depths should be interpreted with caution given sample sizes (n=664–3,404).
Uncertainty calibration is NOT DEMONSTRATED: empirical 1σ coverage ~12.9% vs Gaussian nominal 68.3%. Predicted σ is strictly uncalibrated model-inferred variance.
Pooled 4D Pearson r (~0.987) is dominated by the vertical temperature gradient and must NOT be interpreted as within-depth spatial reconstruction skill. Within-depth mean r for GLORYS is ~0.46.
Results are configuration-specific: this model was trained on a specific 130-day training window and evaluated on a specific 50-day holdout. Results may differ under different splits.
